display.purpose: Oswald Medium condensed caps with wide tracking: action-bar title, cell engravings, nameplate, range labels.

body.purpose: Platform condensed sans for list-row primary text.

mono.purpose: Monospace for every measured value: Hz readouts, song keys, octaves.

motion.name: breath
motion.purpose: Modulates the sounding cell's bloom (0.82 + 0.18·sin) and fill (0.9 + 0.1·sin) while any note sounds; disabled under reduce-motion.

components.name: Instrument Cell (resting)
components.description: A glass cell on the panel: surface fill, hairline rim, inner anode ring, engraved note letter.
components.css: .ds-cell { width: 88px; height: 88px; border-radius: 50%; background: #E7E8E9; border: 1.5px solid #B7B9BC; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; } .ds-cell::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(85,88,92,0.27); } .ds-cell-label { font-family: 'Oswald', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 40px; color: #1C1E20; }

components.name: Instrument Cell (sounding)
components.description: The one luminous element: lit fill, 3px lit rim, radial bloom leaking across the panel (dark-mode values).
components.css: .ds-cell-lit-stage { width: 220px; height: 220px; background: #0E0F10; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-cell-lit { width: 88px; height: 88px; border-radius: 50%; background: #F2EFE6; border: 3px solid #F2EFE6; box-shadow: 0 0 60px 30px rgba(242,239,230,0.45); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; } .ds-cell-lit::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(16,18,20,0.43); } .ds-cell-lit-label { font-family: 'Oswald', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 40px; color: #101214; }

components.name: Range Selector
components.description: One machined frame with two range positions; the selected row carries an ink wash and a lit dot.
components.html:
C TO B
F TO E
components.css: .ds-range { width: 200px; border: 1.5px solid #B7B9BC; border-radius: 5px; background: rgba(231,232,233,0.92); overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Oswald', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; } .ds-range-row { position: relative; height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; letter-spacing: 0.16em; font-size: 15px; color: rgba(85,88,92,0.75); } .ds-range-row + .ds-range-row { border-top: 1px solid rgba(183,185,188,0.63); } .ds-range-selected { background: rgba(28,30,32,0.1); color: #1C1E20; } .ds-range-dot { position: absolute; left: 18px; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #141618; }

components.name: List Row
components.description: Note/song row: condensed name, mono trailing datum, hairline divider; pressing lights it like a cell.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 20px; background: #DADBDC; border-bottom: 1px solid #B7B9BC; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row-name { font-family: 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; color: #1C1E20; } .ds-row-data { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #55585C; } .ds-row:active { background: #141618; } .ds-row:active .ds-row-name { color: #F2F3F4; } .ds-row:active .ds-row-data { color: #F2F3F4; }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: Engraved mono label for grouped settings/lists.
components.css: .ds-section-header { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #55585C; padding: 12px 20px 4px; }

components.name: Steel FAB
components.description: Add-song FAB in plate-surface with ink glyph; never accent-filled.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab" aria-label="Add song"><svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#1C1E20" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-fab { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: #E7E8E9; border: 1px solid #B7B9BC; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-fab:active { background: #DADBDC; }

narrative.overview: Pitch Perfect is drawn as a piece of precision lab hardware, not a grid of platform buttons. The light variant is a bench-aluminum plate; the dark variant is blackened steel. Both are grayscale to the bone. Every surface carries machined texture: brushed grain, an etched five-line staff engraved into the panel, hairline anode rings inside each glass cell. The one moment of light is functional, not decorative: when a note sounds, its cell ignites white-hot with a radial bloom, the note name and live frequency digits appear in the ring's hole, and the glow breathes on a slow 4-second cycle. Release, and the panel goes dark again.
keyCharacteristics: Grayscale only; zero chromatic color anywhere in first-party UI
One luminous element maximum, and only while sound exists
Engraved condensed caps (Oswald Medium, wide tracking) for labels; monospace for every measurement
Hairline strokes (1–1.5px) as the primary structural device; near-square 2dp corners
Identical tokens and instrument geometry on both platforms; chrome stays platform-native

rules.name: The One-Glow Rule
rules.body: The sounding note is the only luminous element on screen. Nothing else blooms, tints, or lights up; all other state is expressed with ink, hairlines, and surface shifts. Silence means a dark (or matte) panel.

rules.name: The Grayscale Rule
rules.body: No chromatic color, ever, in first-party UI. The seed contract and PRODUCT.md both pin it. Third-party ad creative inside the ad slot is the only place color may appear, and it is quarantined there.

rules.name: The Mono-Measurement Rule
rules.body: Any value with a unit or a key — Hz, octaves, song keys — is set in monospace at secondary weight. Names get the condensed face; numbers get the mono face.

rules.name: The Etched-Not-Cast Rule
rules.body: Depth reads as engraving into one solid plate — hairlines, grain, and inset rings — never as layers floating above it. The only light source is the sounding note.

dos: Do keep every first-party pixel grayscale, drawing from the eight plate-* role pairs.
Do reserve plate-lit for the sounding note, its bloom, the pressed row, and the range dot — light means "this is live."
Do set measured values (Hz, keys, octaves) in monospace and labels in condensed caps with wide tracking.
Do build structure from 1–1.5px hairlines and tone shifts; keep corners at 2dp (5px for machined frames).
Do mirror instrument tokens and geometry exactly across platforms while keeping nav/tab/bar chrome native.
Do honor reduce-motion settings by stopping the breath entirely, and give every custom-drawn control a virtualized accessibility element with a full spoken note name.
donts: Don't introduce chromatic color, saturated themes, or a second glow — one luminous element, only while sound exists.
Don't use drop shadows or elevation overlays; depth is etched (grain, staff, anode rings), never cast.
Don't replace the engraved "♯/♭" cell glyphs with full note names on the face; full names belong to the center readout and accessibility tree.
Don't style the FAB or any control with an accent fill; steel surface + ink icon is the ceiling.
Don't let anything but third-party ad creative occupy the ad slot's color exemption, and don't move the slot from its fixed position above the nav.
